scope: ShipDeck lifecycle fact-source ownership and explicit ingress decision gate after T-FO06CP

ownershipDecision.reason: No audited seam combines stable protocol identity, server/protocol ownership, coordinator-compatible generation lineage, strict ordering and terminal invalidation.

ingresses.stableIdentitySource: explicit owner-reviewed stable protocol ShipId; ShipNetworkObjectId is supplemental cross-check only; current NetworkObjectId-derived npcInstanceId is rejected
ingresses.generationLineageSource: new lifetime boundary; fact has no synthetic generation; coordinator allocates fresh never-reused ShipLifetimeGeneration
orderingGuarantees: must be first event for the stable ShipId
duplicate active registration and stale/reused lifetime are rejected
ingresses.terminalGuarantees: Matching ShipInvalidated must later close this lifetime; recreate requires a new explicit registration/lifetime.
failClosedWhenEvidenceMissing: do not create a fact without stable ShipId
do not infer identity or generation from IsSpawned, NetworkObjectId, Unity/NGO reference or callback arrival
reject missing server/protocol ownership, accepted registration or required supplemental identity
